description:
Execute SQL against the site database. The bridge classifies the statement: SELECT/SHOW/EXPLAIN/DESCRIBE/WITH need `db:read`; anything else needs `db:write`. Writes are routed through the Guard: dry_run previews impact in a rolled-back transaction, destructive writes auto-snapshot the affected table(s), and approval applies if the key requires it.

Args:
  - sql (string): a single SQL statement using the site's real table prefix.
  - site (string, optional): target alias.
  - dry_run / approval_id / force: guard controls (writes only).

approval_id.description: Approval id returned by a previous call that needed approval. Re-pass the SAME args plus this id once an admin approves.

dry_run.description: If true, return what WOULD change without modifying anything. Nothing is persisted, snapshotted, or queued.

force.description: Proceed even if a pre-op snapshot could not be taken. Irreversible — use sparingly.

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.

name: bridgistic_db_query
title: Run a SQL query
